query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ocr_correction_patterns` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`field_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
	`incorrect_pattern` text NOT NULL,
	`correct_pattern` text NOT NULL,
	`pattern_type` enum('exact','regex','fuzzy') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'exact',
	`confidence` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`feedback_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	`success_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`failure_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`status` enum('active','pending','disabled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
	`created_by` int,
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `ocr_correction_patterns_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
)
